params.name: AccountSID
params.description: Unique identifier for the partner account.

params.name: CampaignId
params.description: Filters contracts by the campaign they belong to.

params.name: Status
params.description: Return contracts with a specific status. If omitted, only contracts where Status is ACTIVE are returned.

params.name: Signatory
params.description: Return contracts with a particular signatory. Matches against both BrandSignatory and PartnerSignatory.

params.name: DateLastUpdatedBefore
params.description: Return contracts last updated before a specific date and time (ISO 8601).

params.name: DateLastUpdatedAfter
params.description: Return contracts last updated after a specific date and time (ISO 8601).

params.name: StartDateBefore
params.description: Return contracts that start before a specific date and time (ISO 8601).

params.name: StartDateAfter
params.description: Return contracts that start after a specific date and time (ISO 8601).

params.name: EndDateBefore
params.description: Return contracts that end before a specific date and time (ISO 8601).

params.name: EndDateAfter
params.description: Return contracts that end after a specific date and time (ISO 8601).
